BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; EXPANDED CORPORATE TAX COMPLIANCE INITIATIVE. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Appropriation.+]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Requirements.+]

[+For the purposes of subdivision 1, "expanded corporate tax compliance initiative" means a program to enhance tax compliance and enforcement activities under the corporate franchise tax, including the identification and collection of tax liabilities from corporations that currently do not accurately report taxable income, calculate a credit, or otherwise pay all taxes owed. bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to taxation; appropriating money for an expanded corporate tax compliance initiative.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; EXPANDED CORPORATE TAX COMPLIANCE INITIATIVE.

Subdivision 1.

Appropriation.

$10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue to develop and implement an expanded corporate tax compliance initiative. This funding is available until July 1, 2029.

Subd. 2.

Requirements.

For the purposes of subdivision 1, "expanded corporate tax compliance initiative" means a program to enhance tax compliance and enforcement activities under the corporate franchise tax, including the identification and collection of tax liabilities from corporations that currently do not accurately report taxable income, calculate a credit, or otherwise pay all taxes owed. The initiative must prioritize compliance and enforcement activities among corporations reporting $25,000,000 or more in Minnesota sales or gross receipts for a taxable year.

Subd. 3.

Restriction.

Amounts appropriated under this section must supplement and not supplant other amounts available for the purposes described in this section.
additions: APPROPRIATION; EXPANDED CORPORATE TAX COMPLIANCE INITIATIVE.

$10,000,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of revenue to develop and implement an expanded corporate tax compliance initiative. This funding is available until July 1, 2029.

For the purposes of subdivision 1, "expanded corporate tax compliance initiative" means a program to enhance tax compliance and enforcement activities under the corporate franchise tax, including the identification and collection of tax liabilities from corporations that currently do not accurately report taxable income, calculate a credit, or otherwise pay all taxes owed. The initiative must prioritize compliance and enforcement activities among corporations reporting $25,000,000 or more in Minnesota sales or gross receipts for a taxable year.
Amounts appropriated under this section must supplement and not supplant other amounts available for the purposes described in this section.
